narrative: The shelf in daylight. A heavy grey cat lies across a thick book, back to the room, tail over the page edge. Beside it, a taller volume stands upright and clear, the cat not on it. No title is legible. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at the shelf and left it.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Lay on the Chaucer, and not on the chronicle.

entities.name: Holinshed's Chronicles
entities.context: In photo: Found Gib lying on the Chaucer
